title: Agentic Operator · RAAS-v1 事件流转图
contentNotes: Candidate identity is shown as a pre-persistence step.invoke from resume-parser-agent, with CANDIDATE_IDENTITY_REQUESTED retained as an independent review entry.
MATCH_PASSED_NO_INTERVIEW is marked inactive because the current match-resume-agent implementation emits only MATCH_FAILED or MATCH_PASSED_NEED_INTERVIEW.
RAAS/HSM approval is shown as an external handoff between MATCH_PASSED_NEED_INTERVIEW and INTERVIEW_INVITATION_REQUESTED.
